verdict: Organic-only this period; a sharp drop in local visibility needs attention.
narrative: Paid advertising ran at zero spend across the full 28 days, so every result this period came from unpaid sources — your Google Business Profile and website. Within that, Google Business Profile actions dropped 86.67% over the last seven days compared to the prior seven, a decline that held across multiple days rather than a single outlier. Website sessions also fell 20% week-over-week, pointing to a broader dip in organic search visibility rather than a one-off event. We're reviewing the Business Profile to identify what's driving the drop and tightening the profile to better convert the visits you do receive into calls. Expect a clearer picture on visibility once we see whether this week's sessions recover.

drop in Business Profile actions over the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days
website sessions in the last 28 days, down 20% week-over-week

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile actions collapsed sharply this week and website traffic is trending down alongside it.
watch_item.fix: We're auditing the Business Profile now — checking listing health, categories, and content — to identify the cause and stabilise visibility before the drop compounds.
